text:
nina: starting onboarding for cust Herring's adapter (herring-lora-0.9) merged onto redwood/shore-13b. adapter does a head-projection reshuffle + small value rescale. running a 600-sample quick-evalpack now.
omar: acceptance gates?
nina: parity on extraction EM, numeric formatting identical (esp currency/date), prefer EM_drop <2%. cost/latency targets unchanged. zero-tolerance on currency token-splits.
zack: quick smoke (fp16) looks fine. int8 small noise. int4 merged artifact shows decimal/token splits for locales and occasional leading-zero drops. stats: baseline EM=92.8%, herring-int4 EM=89.0% (delta -3.8%), ll_mean delta -0.27.
ci-bot: infra tokenizer version tok=1.4.3, customer provided tok=1.2.5.
omar: can tokenizer mismatch explain it?
zack: partially. re-ran merge with tok-1.2.5 pinned: EM improved to 90.7% but still short. suspect head-projection reshuffle changed token embeddings alignment near punctuation, amplified by int4 bins.
nina: plan: 1) avoid hard merge for canary; use stitch overlay (residual apply) 2) export fp16 and run quantize-aware calibration with customer's tokenizer and their locale corpus 3) collect per-layer bin-occupancy and per-token entropy delta 4) run a 2k evalpack before any canary.
omar: agree. also add a runtime fallback variant shore-13b-int4-safe and a routing rule if EM_drop >2%.
zack: logging a few counterexamples below for triage: ```
# counterexamples (int4 merged)
1) baseline -> "Total: $1,234.50" | herring-int4 -> "Total: $1,234 .50"
2) baseline -> "Invoice date: 2026-03-05" | herring-int4 -> "Invoice date: 2026-3-5"
3) baseline -> "Amount: ,000.00" | herring-int4 -> "Amount: \u0010,000. 00"
```
eval-bot: automated micro-eval summary: quality_regression=true, primary_metric=EM_drop, value=3.8%, ll_delta=-0.27, token_boundary_anomalies=18/600. recommended_actions=["stitch_overlay+tok_pin","quant_calib_with_cust_toks","collect-kv-diffs","run_full_2k_eval"].
nina: omar, can you queue a canary with stitch=true, tok_pin=tok-1.2.5, calib_samples=5000 on a dedicated warm pool? include per-token entropy delta and a token-boundary-change counter.
omar: queued job id=herring-canary-4321, pool=dedicated-shore, expected runtime ~3h. I've added a CI gate note: fail PR if token_boundary_anomalies >0.5% on 5k calibration set.
zack: I'll add instrumentation for layer-wise bin histograms during quant-calib to see whether punctuation tokens get pushed across bin thresholds.
nina: also request customer's tokenizer artifacts + small locale corpus. if stitch+calib doesn't drop EM into acceptable range, we'll keep the adapter shadowed and route to shore-13b-int4-safe for production.
ci-bot: noted: scheduled job herring-canary-4321 at 2026-06-17T15:12Z. will post results when finished. :robot_face:
omar: thanks all 680 - please paste the eval CSV and 10 counterexamples when the job finishes so we can file a regression ticket if needed.
nina: will do. leaving this thread open for canary updates.
